title: Verify all constraints before answering
guidance: If the question contains multiple identifying details (year, duration, color, location), verify ALL of them using GetAttributeDetails before proceeding. Do not assume the first entity match is correct without checking constraints.

title: Trust verified KB data over intuition
guidance: Once you have verified a fact through KB tools (e.g., COUNT returned 3, or GetAttributeDetails returned a value), trust that result. Do NOT second-guess or downgrade your confidence after verification. Tool results are ground truth.

title: Match the correct qualifier when multiple exist
guidance: Relations and attributes often have multiple qualifiers (point_in_time, for_work, ceremony, location, role). Parse the question word (When/Where/What role/What ceremony) to select the RIGHT qualifier from GetEdgeQualifiers results.

title: Use FindByAttribute for unique identifiers
guidance: When the question contains a unique code, ID, URL, or ISNI, use FindByAttribute for exact reverse lookup. It is faster and more accurate than semantic search with FindNode.

title: Use SPARQL for complex conditions
guidance: For OR conditions (UNION), multi-hop joins (>2 hops), or large set operations, use RunSPARQL directly. Individual tool calls are slower and may miss results. Always use COUNT(DISTINCT ...) with UNION to avoid double-counting.
